name: frpc
description: FRP client executable. It connects to frps and exposes a local client port through a remote server port.

params.name: instance_name
params.label: Instance Name
params.description: Unique name for this frpc instance. It controls config/log/pid isolation.

params.name: server_addr
params.label: FRP Server Address
params.description: frps server IP or domain, for example 1.2.3.4 or frp.example.com

params.name: server_port
params.label: FRPS Control Port
params.description: frps bindPort. This is the control connection port used by frpc to connect to frps, not the exposed business port.

params.name: proxy_name
params.label: Proxy Name
params.description: Name of this proxy rule. It should be unique on the same frps server.

params.name: proxy_type
params.label: Proxy Type
params.description: FRP proxy type. For local port forwarding, usually use tcp.

params.name: local_ip
params.label: Client Local IP
params.description: The local IP address on the client machine that frpc should forward to.

params.name: local_port
params.label: Client Local Port
params.description: The local port on the client machine. For example, Vite dev server usually uses 5173.

params.name: remote_port
params.label: Server Exposed Port
params.description: The port exposed on the frps server. External users connect to server_addr:remote_port.
